optional_installed_clients.ssh: OpenSSH compatibility sessions and SSH-based X11 forwarding
optional_installed_clients.mosh: Mosh client and corresponding server with UDP connectivity
optional_installed_clients.xfreerdp3: Preferred external FreeRDP client when available

remote_requirements.SCP compatibility mode: POSIX remote host with Python 3 and a supported atomic rename primitive
remote_requirements.SSH X11 forwarding: A local X server and SSH server support for X11 forwarding

linux.libpcap: Live capture is available only with the operating system's compatible libpcap and existing capture privileges.

macos.libpcap: Live capture is available only with the operating system's compatible libpcap and existing capture privileges.

linux: glibc and shared libraries listed under linked_libraries
OpenGL with the host driver, EGL or GLX and associated display client libraries
OS certificate store for network TLS
optional xdg-desktop-portal and xdg-open for file integration
windows: Native Windows desktop with OpenGL drivers and the OS certificate store
PowerShell, Explorer and Windows console support for local integration
Microsoft Visual C++ runtime if imported by the native binaries
macos: macOS 14 or later for managed display capture/control and ScreenCaptureKit
Native macOS desktop/OpenGL frameworks and the OS certificate store
POSIX shell and open for local integration
